decision.rationale: The official UBC Research-based Theatre Lab homepage identifies Vancouver campus and describes collaborative research involving researchers, artists and community members, including UBC School of Social Work research. Public research projects and publications are useful beyond a personal profile. Map evidenced introductory workshops, participation and news sections separately from the research-purpose fallback.

rules.rationale: The homepage names the introductory research-based theatre workshops as a learning section, despite the historical research-themes path.
Homepage Get Involved and Events navigation offers participation in the lab's collaborative activities.
The homepage explicitly identifies a News section.
The homepage identifies current research projects and publications, including presentations and videos, as the lab's research outputs.

fallback.rationale: The lab's stated purpose is theatre as research and collaborative initiatives among researchers, artists and community members.
